physicalEvidence.summary: Co-GLANCE (June2026) uses VLM-supervised compact onboard perception with calibrated uncertainty to guide simultaneous real DJI Matrice600 and Boston Dynamics Spot deployments. The aerial robot acquires viewpoints and issues waypoints that the ground robot follows. Bhatt is an equal-contribution author. This is pre-UT Dallas work at UT Austin; comparable equipment in the new lab is unverified. The active-perception rule is heuristic, so do not describe it as end-to-end learned control.
